title: The animated film one person made with AI in 2 hours

The AI video tool one creator used to replace an animation studio
The Pixar-quality animated short made by one person for free
How an AI video tool built this animated film in a single afternoon
caption:
One script, one AI tool, and two hours of work produced an animated short that looks like it came from a major studio.

The creator used Seedance 2.5, an AI video generator, and a script called Sherpa by Pocket FM. No animation team. No render farm. A typical Pixar production takes hundreds of people and several years of work. This was one person working for an afternoon.

Seedance 2.5 is available to use online right now.
